title: XXR document signer key (Country A, Taifafeki)
description: The private key of XXR's document signer certificate (DSC), kid kW/6VnwPRKI= (hex 916ffa567c0f44a2), whose public DID document is on the GDHCN DEV trust list (did:web:tng-cdn-dev.who.int:v2:trustlist:-:XXR:DSC, as the DEV host serves it; the guide prints the production host, smart-trust-tools OI-34). XXR is a Trust Network Participant.
